hook: Meet our #1 best selling bag - carries up to a 15" macbook, made from high quality vegan leather.

ad.caption: ooomay.com
ad.copy: Meet our #1 best selling bag - carries up to a 15" macbook, made from high quality vegan leather.

reviews.text: La qualità della borsa è in linea con il prezzo reale pagato. L'azienda propone costantemente uno sconto del 50% pubblicizzato sul proprio sito, se ne deduce che il prezzo relae non è quello pieno, ma quello scontato perennemente. Inoltre ho il forte sospetto che l'azienda venda solo dietro "commessa" ovvero non appena raggiunto un certo quantitativo di richieste manda in produzione la borsa. Ho ordinato il 19/03 e mi è stata consegnata dopo 2 mesi dopo che comunque risultava "disponibile" sul sito ma, in realtà, andata out of stock. L'azienda è stata carina nello spedirmi un piccolo presente senza alcun costo aggiuntivo. Il servizio clienti è stato comunque sempre presente e disponibile.
My order never came, customer service gone AWOL

Jeg bestilte en taske til julegave i midt december og har stadig ikke modtaget tasken, når jeg skriver får jeg svar af en chatbot, som siger at beskeden videresendes til en ansat, men får aldrig svar! Det virker til at være ren fusk og bedrag, køb ikke fra denne hjemmeside!
De tas werd binnen 14 dagen geleverd. Ziet er mooi uit en stinkt absoluut niet. Tot dusver prima aankoop!

Jeg bestilte en taske for over en måned siden, jeg har ikke set noget til den.. når jeg har spurgt dem hvor den bliver af, siger de den er på vej, men der sker intet og når jeg vil have mine penge tilbage, så svarer de ikke. 
Kæmpe scam.
good deal..
ugly and way too big, maybe some people like it but i really dont, feels like a waste of money.
nice bag for the price. not as nice as my LV bag but that one did cost $400, so cant complain too much
Pésima calidad y nula durabilidad
i was happy with this bag, but then i noticed a wierd smell coming from the inside, kinda smells like glue or fish? iv never smelled something like it maybe some wierd chemical they use.
i was happy with this bag, but then i noticed a wierd smell coming from the inside, kinda smells like glue or fish? iv never smelled something like it maybe some wierd chemical they use.

Customer service is extremely unhelpful. I wanted to return an item and contacted them by email, as stated in their instructions. However, when copying the contact email from their website into a mail app, it changes to a different address — something to be aware of if you try to reach them. It has now been over a month, and I still haven’t received any response. On top of that, it also took a month for the bag to be delivered.
dosent fit all my school items, i think i need to just get a backpack but i wish ooomay sold a larger version of this same bag, that would solve my problems.
Stinks like a fish and its already ripping a little
i really like the colour and the stiching, however it smells like the bottom of a barrel of fish on a sunday morning

i can barley fit my arm in here, looks cute but idk if ill use it that much, i have other bags with longer straps, this one should be adjustable, id totally order another one if they sell sone that has an adjustable strap

Tas binnen ik wil hem graag retouneren, dat kan dus niet via de site daar geven ze aan dat je moet mailen en dan een retour label kan krijgen. Ik heb nu 3 keer gemaild in zowel Nederlands als Engels en 0 reactie. Ontzettend slecht!!!!! Koop hier geen spullen

perfect bag for my outfits, i love wearing dresses so i needed a classy and eligent looking bag to match, and this worked really well, only reason i cant give it a 5/5 is the smell, the inside smells like glue, so i had to leave it outside for a few days
3 weeks to get it, way too long

Habe eine Tasche bestellt und wollte diese zurückschicken weil sie mir nicht gefallen hat und sie unpraktisch war. Habe dem Verkäufer drei mal geschrieben und keine Antwort bekommen. Erst als ich einen Paypal Fall eröffnet habe kam eine Mail zurück in der stand dass ich die Rücksendekosten (nach Miami) selbst tragen muss - auf der Website steht diesbezüglich kein Wort! 
Bloß nicht dort bestellen!
3 weeks before i got it, not happy with that took way to long :(

i got a red bag instead of the black one i ordered, even check it 3 times to make sure it wasent me, however once i contacted customer support (6 days ago) i havenet gotten a response back yet, im worried i wont get a refund

I placed my order at the end of December. More than 15 days have passed and the order has still not been shipped.
I have only received automated, AI-generated replies that do not resolve anything. I was even sent “satisfaction surveys” despite the issue never being solved.
At one point, they claimed they did not have my shipping details, even though the order was successfully placed and paid for.
I have requested a refund because I no longer want the item. Taking payment, failing to ship, and then avoiding resolution through automated responses is unacceptable.
I have also seen customer complaints being removed from this company’s Instagram page, which raises serious concerns about transparency and how negative feedback is handled.
Based on this experience, I would not recommend buying from this store.

Ik heb een verzoek voor een return ingediend en in 1e instantie kreeg ik een aardige mail terug met het bericht dat ik het naar de verkeerde afdeling had gestuurd. Dat was raar, want op de website stond het email adres vermeld waar ik mijn verzoek moest indienen. Ze gaven in de mail aan dat ze mijn verzoek zouden doorsturen naar de goede afdeling. Vanaf dat moment hoor ik niets meer! 9 december verzoek gedaan en inmiddels heb ik 2 mails gestuurd met het verzoek om 1 tas te retourneren (kleur was niet goed) met de vraag hoe de retourprocedure gaat. Maar ik hoor helemaal niets meer! Erg slecht dit

I don’t normally leave reviews but since this site has soooo many bad reviews and I had a very good experience with them I thought it only far to share.  I ordered the Julie bag for my daughter, to be honest afterwards when I read the reviews I thought I had be scammed. The bag arrived yesterday after 10 days of ordering it. The bags lovely, no smell (a smell is common and can normally be removed by airing the product or using baking soda). My daughter is very pleased with her order.

Horrible customer service - it's been a week since I placed the order and the item has not even be shipped yet. Whenever I reach out, an AI not sends the same automated reply. The customer service team is either non existent or doesn't take any accountability towards serving their customers. The items are not cheap - so, I guess the Company is simply scamming people. Highly disappointing.

I’d do 0 if I could. No email can be sent to them to refund me. Never got my purchase. I bought it for my wife and my status says “failed attempt” after it being “out for delivery” for a day entirely. No one ever came to my doorstep to deliver that day. I have a doorstep camera. I got scammed right before Christmas, how crazy.

After using this bag for a few weeks now i dicided to order the red one as well, really nice bag, good job ooomay! shipping was a little expensive tho, i hate living in canada most brands charge extra shipping cost for canada, witch sucks, maybe ill move so that wont happen anymore
Awful experience, bag much smaller than described (doesn’t fit a laptop), strong smell and unable to return item. Avoid at all costs
If I could I would give them 0, never received  my ordered from them, got  scammed terribly. They’re not trustworthy at all

Horrible customer service!  Delayed communication by email only and after showing proof of my purchase they said they could not locate my order #.  I never received my order, nor have they refunded the money or offered any other solution.  Do not order from here!

Looks good but i think its a little big for what i needed it for, i also got the hannah bag and that works better for me, was more cute and stylish, aslo the zipper works better on the hannah bag, then the maya, the maya zipper seems to get stuck on itself alot witch is annoying but other then that its a pretty good bag.
Feels and looks quality
i take this to wokr everyday and my co workers love it too! some of them even ordered a bag for themselves

works well but color isent what i was hoping for, the brown is way too glossy, i wanted more of a matte / satin finish, its also kind of greesy feeling but i guess its fine, other then that really nice bag. i take it to school every day now

To be honest, my first purchase experience was not great. When my bag arrived, it REEKED of a fishy smell. I immediately emailed Ooomay, and they gave me instructions on how to fix the smell. When I told them none of those things worked, they worked with me to send me a brand new bag. That bag was much better and I really appreciated them sending me a new one! They were quick to respond, and make sure I was helped.

I read the reviews and was really concerned. However, the bag arrived within the 12 days advised there isnt any smell to it and it even had a small smelly bag in it. It's a gift so can't comment any further but so far so good
Echt schlechte Qualität für diesen Preis
Terrible quality and smells awful, charged a high price for it feel so scammed.

I ordered the Maya bag and upon recieivinug it I immediately noticed a foul chemical smell. Even after letting the bag air out for weeks it still stinks. 
I complained as they have a "100% satisfaction guarantee" but the only way to get a refund is to ship the bag. back to norway which costs as much as the bag itself. On top of that there was no way for me to review the product on the website and warn others. This company should really be banned from operating.
Reported them to ACCC, scam do not purchase. Never receive your item and they never respond to emails.

I placed an order the 24th of AUGUST, it’s the 30th September and I’ve not seen even the shadow of this bag. So disapponting, Í pointed out the first time the bag never came although the shipping update had been changed to delivered (NEVER HAPPENED), they said sorry and made me file a form to send it to me AGAIN. Ok they give me another tracking number and I really believe this time it’s coming, yea again NEVER HAPPENED. Today I got an email with a shipping update saying the bag was delivered on the 25th, I was home all day….
Just please do not buy, go on Temu they cost waaaay less
It took almost a month for my bag to arrive. When it did, it had an awful smell that still lingers. I wish I had done more research before buying, the reviews on their website are totally misleading!

I ordered the Maya bag, at first the smell was a bit weird. After reaching out to customer support they sent me a new bag with a scent bag in it. The smell is really good and i am really really happy with the bag! I saw a lot of negative reviews, but i don’t agree with them!

I bought a bag and it took a few weeks to get to me, the bag came with missing parts where logos were supposed to be but it was blank. The bag smells so bad, it smells like rotting fish and the smell isn’t going away like they said it would. Would not recommend buying from this website.

I ordered the MAYA bag in espresso with zipper and two bag charms, September 4th. I had contact with customer service regarding some personal issues, but response was fast and good. Shipping time was according to what was mentioned on the website. I received the bag and charms today, September 15th. I could not be more happy. Very cute and quality is great, and the most important part: my laptop fits (;
N’achetez surtout pas sur ce site!
Good customer service and the bag is very good quality.

Compré un bolso hace un mes y tras el pago no he vuelto a saber nada de ellos. Te envían un correo electrónico sin ningún numero de pedido y luego es imposible contactar con ellos. Es un fraude, no compreis a traves de esta página.

I bought a bag which was alot smaller than expected and wanted to return immediately,  but the companies customer service is awful. The email providedto start a return is invalid and no one gets back to you when you try to contact them through various other channels. 
Will never buy from  this company again, they are scammers

Tas werd in de regen in de bosjes gelegd bij bezorging, werd gezegd dat ze hem in de brievenbus hadden gedaan dus een dag kwijt geweest. Daaarna maak ik het pakketje open en ruikt de tas helemaal naar vies. De geur is er ook niet uit te krijgen. Al mijn spullen erin ruiken erna ook naar vis, slechte ervaring dus en retouren gaat met geen mogelijkheid..
I got the bag 2 weeks after I bought it. That’s not a really big deal. But the SMELL de bag is soooo stinky I could literally smell the bag from 2 meters away.

Absolute nightmare! I ordered a bag 3 weeks ago, to this day I don’t have neither the bag nor the information about its whereabouts. The tracking shows that it’s delivered successfully at Washington,USA, mind you the place of destination is Vancouver, Canada. Tried to reach out through emails or phone, no answer. Horrible customer service, tracking system, and the experience generally.

Absolutely ridiculous, yes it came on time but the bag itself is advertised to fit a 15" inch laptop the maya bag plus when it came is reeked so so bad and yes u say leave it outside and I have since yesterday but it just won't go away, plus return is horrendous u email them and they say shipping fees are high so u pay shipping fee so they gave me the alternative of keeping the stinky bag with a 20%refund I Absolutely do not want to keep it, I was being nice to them on email so they could be nice and compromise but all in all buy ur uni bags from berksha x

This is NOT a trustworthy brand! They don't provide the quality that they advertise, and they don't offer refunds!!! They try to scam you with offering a 20% refund so they don't lose their profit, but judging by the quality of the bags I highly doubt production even costed them 5%. And on top of that they don't want to answer any question about their manufacturer and ghost you if you say no to their shitty offer.

Om te beginnen heb ik bijna 1,5 maand gewacht op mn tas, die ook op andere Chinese sites zoals temu/shein/amazon te bestellen is en dan binnen 14 dagen binnen is. Eenmaal toen de tas binnen was rook deze onwijs naar vis en ik heb tot dit moment de geur er nog niet uit gekregen. Terug sturen heeft schijnbaar ook weinig zin aangezien je dan ook onwijs lang op je geld moet wachten. Ik bestel hier zeker niet nog een keer
Eles não respondem o meu e-mail, a minha bolsa veio com um cheiro horrível e será impossível usa lá assim, pessimo atendimento!!!!
I’ve been emailing them for weeks to do a return but no one is getting back to me. You can also get the exact same bags on shein for way cheaper.

NUNCA compréis en esta pagina web. Al principio, pedi un bolso (concretamente el Maya) y me llego con un olor horrible. Contacte con ellos y me dijeron que me mandarían uno nuevo. Cuando lo recibí, todo estaba bien, excepto que al poco tiempo, se me rompió casi por completo sin apenas utilizarlo. El bolso es de pésima calidad. Me volvi a poner en contacto con ellos para recibir un reembolso. Al principio me dijeron que encantados me devolverían el dinero, pero llevan meses ignorandome y dandome largas. Son unos timadores y todo esto es nefasto.

Virkelig dårlig kvalitet. Spændet på tasken ligner noget der er løgn. Det er ærgerligt at der er gået 'materialer' til at lave sådan en taske, når man nu troede at det var god kvalitet. 

Kan forstå på flere at dette er en scam-hjemmeside og at ejeren blot videresælger billige ting fra noget á la SHEIN, temu eller alibaba, til en højere pris. Super ærgeligt at jeg ikke var opmærksom, men så kan jeg bare håbe på at andre bliver det, efter denne anmeldelse..

Note til selv: læs altid trustpilot inden du køber ting fra ukendte hjemmesider!

If I could give 0 star. I will definitely give them 0. 
No accountability. Do not care about their customers complaints.
I ordered Julie bag from them on 10th of May and received on the 23rd of May. I made a complaint on the same day I received them due to bag has a lot of issues - loose stitching, damages and smells. I asked for refund and I’m happy to return the item back to them so I asked for the return invoices. At first they gave me choice of returning the bag or replaced them. Take note they responses quickly. But they informed me that I’m not allowed to get a refund as they said “as it has been more than 30 days since you received it” how impossible is that where I emailed them on the same day I have received the bag lol. And it has been few days now still has not heard anything back from them. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS WEBSITE AT ALL. They will scam you. They advertise the 13inch laptop would fit but it did not. They do give false information about their products.

Absolut minderwertige Qualität, bei SHEIN wäre eine Tasche dieser Qualität zumindest günstiger gewesen. Größe der Tasche täuscht auf den Bildern. Absolute Billigware aus China, die teurer verkauft wird. Veganes Leder = Plastik. Material ist nicht so weich, wie es die Bilder scheinen lassen. Ich bereue es die Bewertungen hier nicht vorher gelesen zu haben.

Would give a 0 star if I could. Terrible customer service, took 13 days for tracking information to update from ‘order placed’ to ‘order in factory’ which is based in China. Ironically had I just ordered directly from Temu or Aliexpress I’d have my bag by now. 

I emailed multiple times about the shipment but only received lame, sorry excuses of a recent ‘public holiday’. Haven’t even received my bag yet but I’m honestly not expecting much.

They sell bags from temu for a higher price unfortunately I can’t add photo but if you go to temu and look for a black purse you will see one that’s looks like theirs Juile bag with exactly the same photo

I purchased ‘The Julie’ bag believing it would fit a 13-inch MacBook, as advertised. The bag I received is only 12 inches wide — it doesn’t fit my laptop at all. Although the company could argue you could fit it vertically, no one wants their laptop sticking out of their bag. I also noted although the quality of the bag seemed okay, the buckle was plastic when I expected it to be metal and the bag had no lining.When I submitted an honest review warning others to double-check the sizing, Ooomay chose not to publish it on their site.
After some research, I found the same exact bag listed on Temu for a fraction of the price ($20.79AUD). It’s a shame that companies can moderate their reviews as heavily as Ooomay clearly does, I truly wish I looked at Trustpilot before I purchased.
I have not bothered contacting Ooomay for a refund or return as I read everyone else's poor experiences. I truly expected better transparency from a company that's most likely making upwards of a $50AUD profit from their bags.

De verzending verliep vlot, binnen de aangegeven tijd. De handtas is zoals aangegeven op de foto's.
Ruikt naar "nieuw", deze geur waait vlug over. Dus niet naar vis, zoals in veel revieuws terug komt.

Mooie handtas, heel tevreden met mijn aankoop.

Absolute rubbish handbag. The quality is terrible. The buckle is like tin. When I contacted them for a refund they said I had to ship it back to Norway at my expense. I checked the website contact details etc and no where does it say it’s coming from
Norway! I’m so annoyed that I got scammed. I’m literally ready to just throw this bag in the bin. Awful!
Cheap quality and stinks like fish 🤢
Wish I read the reviews before purchasing. I've had the bag for 17 days and CANNOT get rid of the disgusting stench. I would expect this from Temu, but from a $70 bag is disappointing. Don't bother

I ordered this bag to New York City, and it arrived a few days later. I was worried reading the reviews, but I love the bag, and it looks like the pictures. I took it to work with me, and it was lovely.
I did a reverse image search of ooomay products in an e commerce app. The exact bags (same photos) are listed there for $3AUD. Don’t waste your money.

I hated the bag I ordered from them. When I contacted the company, I was told I would have to ship the bag to NORWAY! For a $49 bag??! They then gave me a 20% refund ($7) to keep the bag. Bags are cheap looking. I could buy something just as "nice" from the local discount store for 1/2 the price. DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THEM!!!

Ich rate jedem davon ab dort zu bestellen! Die Tasche kam bereits beschädigt mit einem Riss bei mir an und die Qualität der Tasche unterirdisch! Auf Anfrage beim Kundenservice die Tasche zurückschicken zu wollen wegen der Beschädigung und Übermittlung von Fotos, kam die Rückmeldung, dass die Firmenpolitik eine Rücksendung und dementsprechende Rückerstattung des Kaufpreises nicht vorsehen würde und nur eine Zusendung eines Ersatzproduktes möglich sei. Dies widerspricht nur leider den eigenen Angaben auf der Website bezüglich Rückgabe und Rückerstattung, sowie der Gesetzeslage in Österreich. Nachdem ich den Kundenservice nach ewigem Hin und Her auf diesen Umstand hingewiesen hatte, wurde kommentarlos die Rückerstattung in Gang gesetzt. Also nicht einschüchtern lassen von den sehr fragwürdigen Methoden dieser Firma und ihren Mitarbeitern, die versuchen ihre Kunden über den Tisch zu ziehen!

Habe dort bestellt und wollte die Handtaschen zurückschicken .. Kundencenter antwortet schnell und freundlich ABER die Retoure würde nach Miami geschickt werden müssen. Mit Sendungsverfolgung etc. um die 50€ und somit fast so teuer wie diese 2 Handtaschen.. Sie baten mir direkt 20% auf meine Bestellung an und dass ich dann die Taschen behalten könnte. 
Habe das Angebot angenommen und darauf verwiesen, dass das Unternehmen dies transparenter gestalten muss! 
Wirkt auf mich wie eine Masche, aber so lernt man draus. Vorher also checken woher wird geliefert und nicht von den „30 Tage Rücksendung“ blenden lassen 🙈

The bag is awful quality and does not represent the pictures! DO NOT BUY FROM THEM, it is a scam 🥲 They also ignored my request for refund and pushed a replacement so my $$$ are gone unless I put the effort in to fighting it. Don’t be like me. Do your research, do not buy (unless your in to paying for something worth 1/4 of the price).

I wish I had read the reviews before ordering.

Save your time, money and faith in company’s caring about customer service and go elsewhere.

My daughter was given a bag for her birthday but the wrong colour had been bought. I asked if we could please exchange it (I said I would cover postage) and I was told the company are not accepting exchanges but I could order another one.

I replied explaining I would cover all costs and then nothing….. no reply.

What a shame.

And honestly, the quality of the products are not good anyway. You could pick something up better from River Island, Zara etc.

Also, just have a read of the reviews - I wish we had.

Advertised as very high quality bags and on discount, I bought this bag. The result was very disappointing and frankly aggravating. I ordered the Julie, it’s very low quality something you buy off SHEIN, and costs £41. When asking for a refund, the process is dodgy as you have to email them and they said you have to ship it to Miami at their warehouse and pay the delivery fees yourself or get a 20% refund. It’s VERY misleading on their website and they do not make this clear. Bag is no where near the quality advertised nor worth of £41.

I can’t explain how incredibly disappointing it is to receive a Chinese tracking label after you’ve just spent a lot of money on something on purpose to get a better quality. I wish I’d have read the reviews on here first, and saved myself from wasting a lot of money. Not looking forward to the bag arriving and not being able to get a refund.

Horrendous experience, terrible customer service from Oomay and iMile delivery contractors and will never shop from this company again.
(And interestingly every time I post this review on the Ooomay website, it gets removed)

After 10+ emails and messages to Oomay and iMile, I finally received my items after a month - far from the advised 5-12 day delivery period. When I contacted Oomay for any assistance as my package had not been delivered, their response was to take no responsibility and simply advise me to “contact the carrier”, appearing to wash their hands of the matter. 

When the items arrived, WELL past Christmas, I was too embarrassed to give them as gifts. Both bags had a pungent chemical smell, and the quality was poor and disappointing. Advertised as “affordable luxury”, these bags are no better than something you would buy from a dollar store, or are similar to a $20 Kmart bag at best. Definitely not worth the $78 I paid, and absolutely not worth the advertised $171 RRP. What other people describe as “buttery soft” is really just cheap shiny plastic. Size is also misleading, is smaller than described and does not easily fit laptop as indicted.
Literally smelled like fish straight out of the bag. Still smells like fish… cute bag but poor quality

This is a potential scam. The same bag (Maya bag) was selling on Amazon for half the price.
 The shape and color were nice but the material is cheap plastic. 
It was ordered in UK, all the prices were in £ dispatched from China but when I tried to return it I was told that I should send it to Miami and due to the high transport cost I should accept 20% discount.
These are certainly not designer bags. This should have been a present but it arrived later than expected as It was not specified that it would be dispatched from China. Also I read the return policy in advance but the fact that I would have to pay the shipping cost to US was also not made clear.
I am waiting for my 20% refund.

Not a scam
I bought a handbag during the Black Friday sale.
The handbag was great. However, we decided to return it because the handbag could not be closed completely.

I contacted Ooomay customer service by email.
Similar to the other reviews, we were told to send the parcel from Vienna to Miami at our own expense.
Instead, we were offered 20% of the price and could keep the handbag.

We thankfully declined, whereupon we received an offer of 30%.
Again we declined with thanks.

After several emails over the holidays (‘Can we send the package now?’) we then got an address.
Shipped with DHL (approx. 12€ shipping costs), the money was transferred back 2 days later.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

Terrible bag & Terrible experience. The fabric of the bag is the worst quality, might give you a skin infection at best or cancer at worst. The packaging is dirty and messy, the order will take weeks to come and you probably will have to email them multiple time. Also smell of stinky fish and they send you a note with the bag to tell you its nothing to worry about - how lame.
Awful company, in USA, which isn’t mentioned when you buy in the UK from them so returns are extortionate

A bit surprised about other reviews. My bag came in in two weeks, just as planned, carefully wrapped. It is cute and looks just like the pictures. Of course it's plastic, but I mean it was clearly labelled as vegan leather (which is precisely that - plastic). I don't think it's the best quality but you wouldn't expect that from the site. Overall I'd say, a little pricey for the quality if you buy full price, but when on sales you get your money worth with a cute fashionable bag.

Didn't have any issue so I can't comment on the customer service.
Came in two weeks just as it said it would. Bag matches the photos and description. Reccommend

Bitte nicht Bestellen. Eine Unseriöse Firma. Homepage enthält kein Impressum. E-Mailadresse auf Widerrufsformular ungültig. Aber man kann über die Homepage unter kontakt aufnehmen jemanden erreichen. Die Antworten sind sehr einfach gehalten und ohne Absendervermerk. Also wissen sie nie mit wem sie kommuniziert haben.
Die Rücksendung bei Widerruf soll in die USA. Da man die Rücksendekosten selber tragen muss und diese bei DHL aktuell 47,99€ kosten, wird keiner dies tun und das Gegenangebot von 20% Rückerstattung akzeptiren.
Deren Begründung ist so primitiv, dass kann nur aus Ostasien kommen.

ABSOLUTELY DREADFUL my daughter bought a bag from here quality is very poor not worth anything like she paid for it she wanted to return it and they initially offered her a 30% refund but are now just ignoring all contact ..... AVOID DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY

Ordered as a gift on 4th December and received on the 14th.
I read the TP reviews AFTER I’d placed my order for a Maya bag. I seriously doubted if I would even receive it. However arrive it did after its long journey from China. 
The bag is okay ish but I’m not entirely sure it’s worth £40. 
It’s advertised as vegan leather and I was not sure what to expect from this. I thought there would be an attempt at a faux leather look. In reality it’s a bag made of a smooth plastic like material. Does not look like leather at all, so leather should not even be mentioned in the description to my mind.
It does have a nice soft feeling and it seems reasonably well made. It is lined and has a magnetic closure.
This one does not smell of fish as some other reviewers have mentioned.
I’m grateful to have received my order, but on reflection and proper research you can get much nicer non leather bags online that come from UK.
I will keep this bag as it seems from other reviews that returning is not easy.

Fuyez cette société 
Produit très bas de gamme
Refus de remboursement ou de retour du produit 
A fuir absolument !

The smell of this bag is absolutely horrific - don’t expect it to “air out” - I’ve had mine for a few months and it still smells strongly of rotting fish. The smell also leaks into anything you put into the bag. Completely unusable.
Super poor quality. Plastic painted buckles. Trying to return but the email doesn’t work and no response from their online message
I ordered the Maya bag and it took 3 weeks to arrive, it looks alright but I can’t get rid of the smell of fish so I can’t use it

I am beyond disappointed with the service I’ve received. From the very beginning, my urgent concerns were ignored, and to be blocked via email? That’s not just unprofessional—it’s downright unacceptable.

For a company that claims to help in all situations, the lack of response is shocking. I’ve reached out multiple times, only to be met with silence. Samantha, I know you’ll read this, and your refusal to address the issue speaks volumes about your attitude toward customer care. It’s not only disgusting but completely unacceptable for someone in your position.

I’ve documented everything, and I’m fully prepared to seek compensation. Ignoring me won’t make this disappear—it only highlights your failure to handle the situation from the start.

Extremely disappointing and a reminder that you need to do better.
AVOID!  The bag itself looks cheap and it STINK OF FISH.  I’ve tried airing it out for days and the smell isn’t going away.  I can’t even use it because the smell is so strong.

DO NOT BUY. Ordered a bag online and it literally smells like dead fish. The smell is so strong and unbearable. The website says you can return for a full refund. It doesn’t say that you have to pay for shipping to ship to another country and will only get 20% of the refund back.

Don’t recommend. Bag arrived smelling super fishy - kept it out on the balcony for two weeks on and off and it still smells just as bad. It’s also very poor quality- I’ve worn it twice and the stitches on the handle are coming apart.
I’ve found the exact bag and model pictures on Temu, SHEIN and Ali express for £6 but is being sold on their website for £40 - AVOID

False advertising of a tote bag £45 dark tan seen in the picture free standing and I was surprised it arrived in the post in a FLAT PACK! The bag was folded and at first they were trying to find ways to deal with me A.k.A u happy customer but then when I wanted to return the item they decided to ghost me. Not reviving any information on the return request which they said I’d have to make sure is gone through before I make the return or I won’t get my money back. Now I don’t have £45 and I’m stuck with a bag that’s good for nothing honestly there’s no better way to describe it. So please reconsider your purchase at oomay they don’t care what they’re selling and they don’t care whose pocket  they are hurting. Awful!

DO NOT PURCHASE FROM OOOMAY - it is a scam. 
Bought two bags there, both were way smaller than described on the website. When trying to send them back I saw that the email indicated on their website was not working. I used the chat offered on the Website but never got an answer.

Poor quality bag - stitching is terrible, the actual vegan leather itself feels extremely rubbery, and plastic hardware that looks like a buckle from a dollar store or costume shop. Return policy is atrocious as I purchased it outside of the US (directly from the Ooomay website!). Tried to leave a review directly on their website but it hasn't been uploaded.

I ordered one bag bc I loved how the looked on insta. Long story short: the quality is very poor. The gold clasp is made of plastic :) you know these pirate costumes when you were young, these cheap weapons out of plastic? Looks and feels the same. The fabric is thin, stinks, is cheap. 
The return to Miami would cost me ca 50€ from Germany. They also offered me 20% - I don’t think that I will get this after reading the comments.. 
I guess I’m just throwing it away. That’s so sad tbh, but this bag really looks like shit. Embarrassing to wear.

Auf keinen Fall etwas bei dieser Firma bestellen. Ich wollte die Tasche zurücksenden, da sie deutlich kleiner war als auf dem Foto und es sich eindeutig um billige Chinaware handelt. 
Leider ist die auf der Homepage angegebene Email-Adresse über die man Retouren anfordern kann nicht existent und die Email kam zurück.
Le sac sent très mauvais! plastique ou je ne sais pas quoi. Essayent de masquer l'odeur avec un sachet sent bon mais ca ne fonctionne pas.

The bag was stinky and stunk of fish and then they didn’t even issue me the refund - forget about full refund they said they were going to give 20% refund but they didn’t even do that… very bad the worst service I have ever used please avoid

I am very disappointed with my Ooomay Julie bag. The photos shown on the website and in the reviews obviously do not match the bag that arrived. I am not giving it only one star because the measurements do match what is written in the size box, but that does not mean that I am not angry and upset with what I received. Also, considering that I have to pay the return completely, I think it would be more expensive to return it than to keep it.

Scammers. I have received the bag I had ordered which was poor quality and got damaged quickly. I emailed customer service and they offered a replacement, which I accepted. Replacement never came, and they have blocked my email so now when I try to send one it bounces back.

Ok let me start by saying the low-star reviews seem suspicious. I don't know if they purchased a bag directly from Ooomay or if they were dumb and thought buying a dupe on Shein/temu, claiming to be Ooomay at a fraction of the cost, and now Oomay is unfairly taking the heat. 

I purchased two bags from Ooomay (The Julie- Black & The Hannah- Brown) after seeing an Instagram ad several times. Both bags were well packaged and smelled nothing of chemicals or glue like I saw in many bad reviews. Each bag had a tag that even noted that if there is a smell, it is due to the lack of ventilation during packaging/ shipping and will subside. Like I said, neither of my bags smelled of any concerning odor.

Quality: Honestly for $45 each, I think the bags are both well made. There isn't any inside lining/frills, which I wasn't expecting anyway. There aren't any compartments/separators in the bags either so if that's an issue for you these might not be the bags for you. 

Shipping, I received my bags within 5 business days of my purchase. Considering it had to go through customs, I was impressed on how quickly I received my items. Overall I am happy with my purchase and don't regret falling for the IG Ad.

This is a Scam Company, I ordered a Bag and it was in an awful quality. Wanted to send it back (from Germany), so I wrote an e-Mail. I quickly got an answer, in which they wrote in german, that I would have to send it to Miami (very expensive!) Or that they could give me a refund over 20 % of the purchase price, because they just wanted me to be "happy". 
Of course at this point I was sure, that this is a Scam Company, but 20% of the price was the Best I could expect, so I answered very nicely that I would be happy with this solution. Since then nothing happened. I even wrote another E-Mail a few days ago and now I got a "Mail delivery Failed", and the Mail Adress seems to not be found.... don't buy bags at this Company!!

Kort geleden heb ik via deze site de maya tas gekocht. Deze kwam aan en bleek enorm te stinken, vergelijkbaar met een visgeur. De geur is er met geen mogelijkheid uit te krijgen en blijkt afkomstig van het materiaal. De geur was zo erg dat zelfs de spullen die ik in mijn tas had zitten nu ook naar vis ruiken.
Begrijpelijkerwijs heb ik hierover de klantenservice gemaild omdat ik mijn geld terug wil. Ik heb tot op heden nog niks van mijn geld terug gezien en de klantenservice is sinds vorige week ook gestopt met terug mailen. Ik zou hier echt niks kopen!
I would give 0 stars if i could. The refund help email they give just bounces and the bag is really really cheap and so not worth the money.  This was meant to be a gift for my daughter.

I ordered a bag for the purpose of carrying my laptop for work and university. When the bag arrived it was a great deal smaller than it appeared in the advertisements. I never would have ordered the bag if I knew how small it was.
When I requested a refund OOMAY advised me that their warehouse is located in Norway and it would be very expensive for me to return the bag as shipping costs would be my responsibility. They they offered me a 20% refund to keep the bag. When I told them I want to proceed with a refund, they offered me a 30% refund. I asked to proceed with a refund requesting the return address. They gave me an address in Florida, when originally they told me the warehouse was in Norway. I agreed to keep the bag for a 40% refund. They agreed and proceeded to refund me approx 33% of the purchase price. The size of the bag was not only deceiving, the quality of the bag is poor. I have seen other similar reviews. Oomay is a dodgy company, save yourself the trouble and don't buy from them. Their customer service policies are low!

I ordered a red OOMAY handbag as a present for my wife - price £38 + postage. It looked very nice in the picture and the blurb said something like 'made of vegan leather' - which I should have known is just sneaky code for 'cheap PVC'.  It arrived after a long wait and... it's so thin and cheap that I was ashamed to present it to my wife - AND it stank so badly that store staff have commented 'what's that smell?' to her.  Primark for £5 = fair enough for a piece of rubbish like this.  £38 = total rip off.  Needless to say I feel cheated and duped, and I will never buy anything from OOMAY again.  If you are reading this, I advise you to avoid these people.  They clearly have no pride or ethics.

Ooomay.com is a scam-company!!! I ordered my bag and when it finally arrived it was made in poor quality and smelled like nail polish. Googled the company AFTER I ordered and I found the exact same bag on Temu. On the company-instagram it looks like they are hiding comments. On their website they clame they sell “stunning bags”, that they “specialize in sustainable fashion” and that their bags is “beautifully and ethically made”. This unfortunately seems to be pure lies. Save yourself the money!!!

I’ve never bought from them, but these reviews made me save 40€. I literally found the same bag and the picture is the same but flipped. It’s 10€ on Amazon. If I have to buy a cheap quality bag at least I pay it for what is worth

Worst page ever. The bag I ordered smelled like chemicals and it came folded right in the middle of the bag, which made a crease that I would never get out. Also the material is the cheapest I've ever seen and definitely not worth the price!! The straps are so thin, it will probably cut into my should. 
And their return policy is a joke. First of all you need to email them why you don't want to keep the item and then rather helping me out about the returning process, they want me to keep the bag and only get a 20% refund for the worst bag I've ever seen. So no dear Ooomay team I don't want to keep the bag and get a 20% refund. I want a full refund even if I have to pay the shipping myself.

Never buying from there again and also definitely not recommending it to anyone

SCAM!! Avoid this company and any purchases from here!! The bag came and it is horrible. It is very poorly made. I tried to request a refund and it's been a month of arguing with the company to get my money back. They won't release the shipping address to return the item, and give the same AI generated response.

Terrible. Bad quality bag and went to return. They took weeks to respond to my comms and then said it was too expensive for me to return so they will offer a 20% discount instead. I said I want to return so they gave me a return address in Miami which looks like it’s a freight company which will obviously then forward to China. After questioning this they have still not responded to my emails. Seems unlikely I will get a refund. Crap product and service!

Customer service is questionable as there were no replies from them for more than a week, messaged them on IG and no replies. All these messages are for my order that was not even received nor did anybody contact me about the delivery. I emailed them that my address needs to be updated, however it’s been sent back to the “Sender”. There were no follow ups, no emails, no replies. Is this actually a shop that sells products or just a scam? Absolutely ridiculous. 

I don’t even write reviews, even if the product’s bad, but you’re an exception. “Ooomay” as well start replying to customers else just close down and stop giving false expectations to customer about your product through your marketing. Thank you.

After emailing the company for the returns address as instructed on their website they emailed me a week later asking for the reason and not sending across the address 

This I assume is to delay the returns process so am I unable to send the item back on time 


Email said 
“Thanks for reaching out.

We're sorry to hear that you want to return your order. May we know the reason for this? Maybe we can clarify some things for you or do something on our end!

I look forward to hearing from you!“

I really wish I read the reviews before I bought this bag, because I've experienced very similar experiences. The bag has a terrible smell, I've tried airing this out but it's so bad that I couldn't wear it in public.

I've reached out for a return via email, Insta and support lines with no luck.

Such a waste a money, the bag is now going into the bin.

Based in the UK and trying to get a refund. Being completely ignored. Bag is ok at best, not worth the £30+ spent on it. Just buy the cheap dupes from Amazon or something. Don't buy from ooomay, waste of time and money.

I’m based in AU and their customer support ghosted me trying to return my bag I received that smelled absolutely foul. Never experienced such terrible service like this before, disappointing. Please contact me.

Bag is cheap and nasty and arrived folded so small it is all creased as well. Certainly not worth the price paid. Customer service are ghosting me and reading the rest of these reviews it seems like I have no hope of a return or refund. Stay away.

My package took longer to arrive because the carrier had trouble delivering it and ended up returning it to the sender. I was a bit frustrated, but ooomay' customer service was fantastic and really came through for me. They quickly sent out a new package, and I'm now loving the bag I got from them. You can tell it is really good quality and perfect for everyday use. Thanks to the great customer service, the wait was worth it!

When i first received the maya bag, i was put off by a strong smell from the vegan leather. I emailed customer service who apologized and told me that this can happen with vegan leather when boxed up for a while. it took a few days of airing out before the odor faded. once the smell went away i was really impressed with the bag. the vegan leather is soft and high-quality, and the design is so cute. despite the initial issue, it's a great purchase!

I've been on the hunt for a sustainable, cruelty-free bag, and I'm So happy I found this one. I bought the julie bag because although I loved the look of the maya bag which is the best seller, something about the julie I loved. The vegan leather is super easy to clean and holds up really well with everyday use. The strap is comfortable even when the bag is full, and I'm obsessed with the minimalist design because it literally goes with everything!

Ça ne mérite même pas une étoile. 
Fuyez, je vous le conseille. 

Les 30 jours de garantie c’est de la douille. 
Vous vous faites justes arnaquer.
On m’a remboursé 20% de mon achat, soit 10€ sur les 55€ que j’ai dépensé.
En plus de ça, pour un sac de mauvaise qualité.

The maya bag is rly cute!! I love the logo engraving and how sturdy the vegan leather feels. It's perfect for everyday use, but I was hoping it would fit a bit more. My 15" laptop does fit, but it's a tight squeeze, especially if I have other bigger items. Still a great bag, just wish it had a little more space so I could carry more.

I absolutely love the design and feel of the Maya bag. The vegan leather is soft, and fits my daily essentials perfectly. However, I'm tall and I found the strap a bit shorter than I would have liked. It's still functional and comfortable to carry, but I wish there was an option for a longer strap. Other than that, I'm really happy with it!!

Omg I am OBSESSED with my Maya bag!! I've been using it for everything—school, shopping, work, you name it. If fits my giant2012 MacBook Pro (which is super heavy), my notebooks, water bottle, and a bunch of other small things. I was counting the days until it arrived, and when it did, the packaging was gorgeous And it smelled amazing because of the scent sachet inside. I love that it's vegan leather—such a huge plus for me. If you're thinking about getting it, DO IT. I'm already eyeing the brown one for my next purchase. 😍
The bags are terrible quality. Don’t order there and save yourself some money.

Saw it on Instagram and purchased immediately. It arrived 2 weeks later and it absolutely STINKS of fish (like how cheap leather smells from fast fashion places). It's also smaller than I expected as well - it can fit my laptop in but no room for anything else.

It is a cute bag but made so cheaply. If I had seen it in person before purchasing I would only pay £10 for it, let alone the "sale" price I paid of £32.

Warning: Do Not Purchase from This Company

I strongly advise against purchasing from this business. It operates as a reselling scam, offering bags from AliExpress and other low-cost websites at exorbitant mark-ups. Upon receiving the Maya bag, I immediately noticed its poor quality, which was entirely unacceptable given the price paid. When I attempted to return the item, I was informed that I would need to ship it back to Miami, despite being located in the UK. The best they could offer was a 20% partial refund if I chose not to send the parcel internationally.

While I have previously returned items to other countries at a reasonable cost, I found it particularly concerning when I learned that the company has a warehouse in Europe. This warehouse is apparently suitable for dispatching items but not for processing returns. Upon further inquiry about the partial refund, I was eventually offered a 40% refund, which I accepted. The customer service representative was vague about the cost of return shipping, refusing to provide specific details until I made a decision on the partial refund. I ultimately opted for the 40% refund, unwilling to be further exploited by this company.

Guys, it‘s NOT a scam. I ordered from Germany and thought fricking so many Bad Reviews but it is her and it dos‘nt smell like Fish at all. I love the bag. Yes it took a but longer to arive but it really looks perfekt also it is shipped so secure. To be onest i orderd one from Shein for  comparison and the Maya bag looks soooo better. The SHEIN on is the one how is smelling awfull and looks cheap

Should have read the reviews!!! Well and truly fell for this one. Bought the 'viral bag' which when arrived absolutely stinks of fish. I have since tried emailing (twice), contacting via Instagram and no response from them in order for me to return the item. All the reviews on the website must be paid "influencer" ones or just plain fake
This bag stinks and although your laptop might fit. It is not as spacious as shown in the videos. Please save yourself some money and avoid it.

I orderd the Maya bag. The bag smells so bad that I'm literally unable to hold it for longer than 3 seconds. My MacBook doesn't fit in the bag either. I've been trying for almost two weeks to return the bag, but they refuse and come up with unacceptable solutions. Stay away from this store, it's a scam.

Used the bag for under a month and it ripped and kept ripping (didn’t even use it for heavy items). No response about a refund. Bag smelled like plastic. Horrible quality for the price, DO NOT BUY!!!!!!! This is such a scam.
Save yourself some money. If you want this bag, order from Temu for $10 or amazon.

If I could give a zero I would. Bag smells terrible and dimensions suggesting the Maya bag could fit laptop was incorrect. No response to my requests for a refund and no information provided about returns. Total waste of money.

Customer service is a joke, return system is a scam. They will quite literally ignore you if you try to return the bag. Should’ve guessed that only customer service returns are sketchy. The bags are terrible quality. Don’t order there and save yourself some money.

**********AVOID OOMAY**********
CUSTOMER SERVICE clearly try to persuade you not to return the Maya bag which is extortionately overpriced as it is drop shipped from China.  A label is then stuck over retailers address 153 Blakeney Way, Kingswood Lakeside, Cannock, United Kingdom, WS11 8LD. This is registered on Companies House as YUNEXPRESS UK LTD
Company number 12982734
Yet if you want to return an item you are informed you have to send it to the US!!  Or you can accept a 20% or 40% (on 2nd email) discount. If only I had read their reviews before ordering!
Customer service is a joke and you can get their popular $45 Maya bag literally anywhere else for half the price. $20 amazon and $5 temu
c'est du drop shiping , vous avez les mêmes sac sur temu à 10 $
Terrible customer service. Maya bag seam on strap ripped open and falling apart within 2 months of 3-5 day/week usage. They offered me 25% off another because I was over 1 month time.

I actually adore the bag I purchased off of this site. I got the black maya bag and I’m in love with it, I’ve been wearing it everyday since I got it and I genuinely have gotten so many compliments when I wear it. After I ordered I saw the comments about it being cheaper on temu and got so nervous but one of my friends bought the temu bag to check it out and it’s literally not even the same bag!!! The quality of the ooomay bag is so much better and the temu bag looks completely different from the photos?? The temu bag says “fashion” on it while my ooomay bag looks just as advertised. I am so happy that it all worked out in the end and will recommend my bag to everyone!!
The delivery is speed but its drop shipping, i buy the red bag even if there are not the red in temu there another color just for 5$ so for ooomay i say no.
These bags are on temu for a fraction of the price. They’re scammers.
about their best-selling maya bag ($45): you can find the exact same bag on temu (exactly the same pictures too) for literally $5
